# biomes/thedome: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

Docs: `BIOME-API.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `NOTES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`

Built output (never open it; edit `src/` and rebuild): `dist/thedome-cleft.html`, `dist/thedome-crown.html`, `dist/thedome-eastflank.html`, `dist/thedome-moat.html`, `dist/thedome.html`

Build: `cd biomes/thedome && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
Fragments marked **big** are over 30 KB: find the section below and read only that range.
